topic.title: Evaluate expressions in the Node.js REPL

task.title: Start the REPL as a surface

step.cmd: Start node -i in a terminal as a process named sessions-repl, and wait for the > prompt.
In the REPL, enter 40 + 2 and press Enter. Wait for the REPL to print 42.

task.title: Run the REPL in the background

step.cmd: Run node -i in the background as a process named sessions-bg-repl, and wait for the > prompt.
In the REPL, enter Math.pow(2, 10) and press Enter. Wait at least half a second, and until the REPL prints 1024.

task.title: Start a server and a REPL together

step.cmd: From the docs/actions folder, start node simple-json-server.cjs as sessions-api, and wait until port 8087 answers. At the same time, start node -i in a 100 by 30 terminal as sessions-client, and give it a second to start.
In the REPL, fetch the server's root URL, and wait for it to print ok.
Close the REPL and the server.
